The window side has 20 7/8" between the heater's face and the RÅDMANSÖ king's frame, and this needs 27 1/4" there (its 21 1/4" front along the head wall plus F-33's 6" off the heater); turned, with its 15 1/8" along the wall, its drawer would open against the bed's side. The bathroom side is the door's 30" landing (F-31). So in a and h the first stands on the bathroom side of the head on his word, 7" into the door's landing at the sketch's door position (clear if the door starts 16" or more from the corner: a move-in day tape), and the second beside the POÄNG reading chair on the left wall in place of the LACK side table (15 1/8" off the wall, 21 1/4" along it); the window side keeps the VIHALS. A drawer with a brass-look knob, an open shelf, cable management for a lamp or a phone charger, black metal legs with 12 5/8" under; contract grade; designer Francis Cayouette. One package 22 ½ x 14 ¾ x 4 ¾", 28 lb 6 oz. Out of stock at IKEA Long Island, NY and unavailable for click and collect; home delivery available (2026-10-26). 4.3 stars (109).
